fields.statement: Plan review round 3 left finding f1 (contradiction on check-guides-evidence-lines): The leaf (and Decision shallow-round-needs-leaf-coverage) treat check-compliance as guidance used by conductors, but internal/guide/text/conduct.md:38 spawns only --role check-plan, check-code and check-qa; check-compliance is the classic review workflow's check (kind checks), which the Decision leaves unchanged. Telling the compliance check that an uncovered leaf is refused in a conductor run describes a refusal it never meets; drop check-compliance.md and check_compliance_test.go from the leaf, or say why a conductor would run it. The critic confirmed it: Real: internal/guide/text/conduct.md:38 has the conductor spawn only --role check-plan, check-code and check-qa, and review.md:7-13 lists check-compliance as the classic workflows' check (docs-review.toml declares it under a kind = "checks" step). The Decision keeps classic checks steps unchanged with evidence optional, so a compliance check never meets the uncovered-leaf refusal; the leaf telling it that such a round is refused in a conductor run, and the Decision's 'check-compliance guidance used by conductors', contradict the code. Major for a contradiction stands. How should it be settled?

Plan review round 3 left finding f2 (no-failure-case on check-round-evidence-status): The acceptance's '(failure case)' is 'a round with findings and no evidence lines prints its findings exactly as before', a regression check of the happy display path, not a failure path of the leaf. run status showing evidence has no input it refuses; the leaf needs either a real failure path (e.g. an evidence line naming a leaf no longer in the change set still prints with its ID and no handle, not a crash) or a failure_waiver giving that reason. The critic confirmed it: Real: the leaf's '(failure case)' is a round with findings and no evidence printing as before, which is the absent-data display path (already covered by its own 'no evidence key' clause), not a failure path of run status's evidence display; the leaf has no failure_waiver. A real failure path exists to test (an evidence line whose leaf no longer resolves, e.g. a leaf retired after the round, must still print with its ID rather than fail), so either that case or a waiver is needed. Major for no-failure-case stands. How should it be settled?
